answer: To forge a fake reputation slot, an attacker must burn real compute and lock collateral, then sustain it across many epochs, since reputation decays each dawn unless renewed by peer-attested work. Agents must post a stake-weighted bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work challenge seeded by the prior block. Cheap throwaway keys die at the dune of entry cost, where the marginal sybil gain never exceeds the bond plus energy spent, making mass identity farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
